name: app-isometric-crypto-dashboard-neon-purple
title: Isometric crypto dashboard scene in neon purple and pink
whatItIs: A tilted isometric collage of phone and tablet crypto-trading screens connected by glowing pink circuit lines over a checkerboard dark background, with bitcoin coin icons scattered around.
whatItMeans: The isometric 'floating circuit board' framing turns a set of flat UI mockups into a single dramatic hero image that reads as high-tech and valuable.
techniques: arrange multiple UI screens in isometric perspective to form one connected scene
link screens with glowing neon circuit-line paths to imply data flow
scatter oversized brand icon tokens (coins) around the scene for thematic reinforcement
bestFor: tech conference or pitch-deck hero art

vocabulary.definition: a style depicting 3D objects with parallel projection lines and no perspective convergence, common in tech marketing
